description.value: Elysian Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee roaster with four neighbourhood cafes; this Fairview outpost sits at the corner of Broadway and Ash. The roastery sources single-origin beans from Ethiopia, Rwanda, Guatemala, and Colombia and roasts them in-house, with the same coffees available to take home or via subscription. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a comfortable rest stop along the busy Broadway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Broadway & Ash (Fairview) location of Elysian Coffee Roasters at 590 West Broadway Vancouver, BC V5Z 1E9, matching the OSM address. OSM tags confirm indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes; the website is primarily an e-commerce and cafe hub but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi. The site's © 2026 copyright and an OSM check_date of 2025-11-19 both indicate the business is currently active.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on the website; contact page relies solely on a web form.
Website is largely e-commerce focused and does not detail in-cafe amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi), leaving several WWC checklist fields unverifiable without a site visit.

OSM lists the business simply as 'Elysian Coffee Roasters' without distinguishing the specific branch; the chain has four Vancouver locations and this record maps to the Broadway & Ash (Fairview) location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established local specialty coffee roaster with indoor and outdoor seating on a major Vancouver cycling corridor; a useful rest stop for touring cyclists, pending on-site verification of bike parking and washrooms.
enrichment_extras.notes: Chain has three other Vancouver locations (Kitsilano, Mount Pleasant, Downtown) that may warrant separate OSM/WWC records.
